mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_captures ( tenant_id, category, capture_date, process_id, currency_id, remark, remove_word, replace_word_from, replace_word_to, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{category}, #{captureDate}, #{processId}, #{currencyId}, #{remark}, #{removeWord}, #{replaceWordFrom}, #{replaceWordTo}, #{createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, category, capture_date AS captureDate, process_id AS processId, currency_id AS currencyId, remark, remove_word AS removeWord, replace_word_from AS replaceWordFrom, replace_word_to AS replaceWordTo, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM data_captures WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
